weaknesses: 'unsafe-inline' enabled without cryptographic nonce/hash (allows arbitrary inline XSS).
strengths: object-src set to 'none' (blocks legacy Flash/Java plugin execution).
recommendations: Remove 'unsafe-inline' and use cryptographic nonces: script-src 'nonce-<random>'

weaknesses: Missing SPF (Sender Policy Framework) record: domain is vulnerable to direct address spoofing.
Missing DMARC record: recipient mail servers have no instructions on how to handle spoofed messages.
MTA-STS not enabled: inbound SMTP connections risk cleartext TLS downgrade via STARTTLS stripping.
recommendations: Add DNS TXT record for owasp.org: 'v=spf1 mx -all'
Add DNS TXT record for _dmarc.owasp.org: 'v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@owasp.org;'
Deploy MTA-STS policy at https://mta-sts.owasp.org/.well-known/mta-sts.txt with mode 'enforce'.
Add DNS TXT record for _smtp._tls.owasp.org: 'v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:tls-rpt@owasp.org;'
